summary: Frontend-only retest of the WAN tab TRACEROUTE (VIA SONDA) card on client 86BIT_Office (da3d6e40-b3e5-4d46-9787-dde328a3aa36). Logged in via UI with info@86bit.it + TOTP 2FA, opened tab WAN (2 targets). Verified (1) the previous JS crash on 'Esegui' is gone — card now shows the graceful message 'Nessuna sonda-agent connessa.' with ZERO pageerror/unhandled exceptions (no 'filter is not a function'); (2) the new '⚖️ Diagnosi colpa' button (wan-fault-diagnose-run) is present, enabled and clickable — POST /api/external-monitor/fault-diagnose returns 503 and a readable Italian toast 'Nessuna sonda live disponibile per la diagnosi.' appears, no crash, no wan-fault-verdict banner (expected without live probe); (3) target select switch + second 'Esegui' run also handled gracefully. critical_code_review_comments: TracerouteCard.run(): agent list parsing now defensive (Array.isArray || data.agents) — good; consider applying the same guard to other places calling GET /api/agents to avoid the same class of bug.
runDiag() sets diag only on success and never clears info; if a previous verdict exists it stays visible after a failed re-run — consider resetting/annotating stale verdicts.
